t2_fields.sampling_material: Human neural retina ex vivo tissue (regional composition: peripheral region of retina 1,568,477, macula lutea 1,077,597, fovea centralis 434,131, macula lutea proper 97,105)
t2_fields.disease_stage: normal (disease column all normal; donors predominantly elderly, with the largest segment in the 90+ age group)
t2_fields.treatment_background: Not recorded (public atlas metadata lacks treatment column) — marked 'Not recorded', no speculation
t2_fields.enrichment_step: Stratification: majority naive; 1,334,033 nuclei via NeuN+ neuronal nucleus sorting (Chen_a/ancestry subset); Chen_rgc study designed for whole-layer RGC enrichment
t2_fields.dissociation_method: Chen_a=0.02% NP40 (nuclear extraction); Chen_ancestry=0.02% NP40 (nuclear extraction); Chen_b_GSE226108=0.02% NP40 (nuclear extraction); Chen_c_GSE247157=0.02% NP40 (nuclear extraction); Chen_rgc=0.02% NP40 (nuclear extraction); Shekhar_GSE237204=unknown
t2_fields.donor_count: Primary tier adult-only 97 donors / 113 donor units; control tier adult_pool 104 donors / 120 units (includes 7 non-adult donors → see excluded_nonadult_units row-by-row, KB2c adjudication Q2 threshold >=18y)
t2_fields.evidence_source: Local empirical recalculation (A) + HRCA paper (B, PMID 41578023) + old KB1 literature anchors

usage_scope: Usage scope (Astra T2 adjudication fixed): This baseline = identity reference for cell composition captured by this sampling material under this experimental workflow + background control; **must not be treated as a composition compliance threshold**. Sampling subjects of disease surgical materials ≠ healthy organs (e.g., PDR fibrovascular membrane must not be validated against healthy retina composition acceptance); appearance of identities outside the annotation data list → trigger unexpected flag only, do not force change to in-list identities (label acceptance requires contextual consistency check, not whitelist positioning).

evidence_grades.A: Local empirical recalculation (with file paths + scripts)
evidence_grades.C: Empirical intervals derived from donor-level/cross-study distribution of A-grade source data
evidence_grades.qualitative: Literature provides only qualitative description → store qualitative only, do not fabricate intervals (Astra T2)
evidence_grades.not_estimable: Interval cannot be estimated — legitimate state, annotation can proceed (Astra T2)

distribution_method: Donor-level: calculate proportions for 10 classes per donor unit first, then aggregate median/IQR/range across donors; stratification = study × enrichment (× site, D002 side); pooled columns are for reference only, subject to large-donor weighting bias
primary_reference_stratum: Primary archive = 6 studies excluding Chen_rgc (RGC-enriched design) and NeuN+ sorted layers from each study, restricted to organism_stage=adult (>=18y) donor units, n=113

fine_types.denominator_note: cell_type column subdivision covers only finely annotated cells within this majorclass; % represents subtype/intra-class annotated cell counts

states.note: retina library legacy_v4 + AUC candidate merge; extremely low proportion in normal retina (HRCA 0.15%)
RPE should be near zero in neural retina specimens; presence triggers RPE/choroid contamination flag
GFAP upregulation = reactive gliosis flag, see disease entries

contamination_suspect: High-MT photoreceptor debris zone (dissociation stress, see disease entries)
Peripheral blood myeloid large cluster (FCN1/LYZ) — blood residue flag for whole-retina specimens

caveats: Single-sample proportions strongly influenced by sampling/sorting design (NeuN± nucleus sorting, RGC enrichment, fovea vs periphery, lobe vs macular): cross-study spread (basis for C-grade interval derivation) = min~max of pooled data from Chen_a/Chen_b/Chen_c/MMD/BCM/Shekhar_legacy 6 groups, excluding RGC-targeted groups.

HRCA 10-class lexical surface excludes endothelial/pericytes (neural retina integration does not include vascular classes). True whole retina contains low-proportion vascular components; small Endo/Pericyte clusters in annotated data represent normal vasculature, do not trigger contamination flag.
High RGC proportions in enriched samples (e.g., Chen_rgc 46.2% RGC, Shekhar legacy 43.6%) are by design; the dataset construction strategy must be checked before flagging as 'abnormal'.

Single-sample proportions strongly influenced by sampling/sorting design (NeuN± nucleus sorting, RGC enrichment, fovea vs periphery, lobe vs macular): cross-study spread (basis for C-grade interval derivation) = min~max of pooled data from Chen_a/Chen_b/Chen_c/MMD/BCM/Shekhar_legacy 6 groups, excluding RGC-targeted groups.

v1.1 (this entry): The proportion metric has been upgraded from 'whole-cell pooled + cross-study spread' to 'donor-level stratified distribution' (Astra T2); the old pooled value is retained in pooled_all_cells for comparison only — among 3.17M nuclei, Chen_ancestry accounts for 42.6%, with large donors dominating the pooled average.

NeuN+ sorted layers systematically elevate neuronal classes and suppress MG·Astro·RPE; do not mix intervals from these two layers unless control samples were confirmed to undergo nuclear sorting prior to processing.

suspension_type all-nucleus — snRNA includes intronic reads (intronic_reads_counted=yes), making direct comparison of class proportions with scRNA cell suspension data invalid (Astra T2: the difference between scRNA and snRNA is sufficient to alter observed composition).

v1.1 (KB2c t_be336eee): Main archive metric upgraded to adult-only (donor_age>=18y, adjudication Q2) — v1.0 mixed metrics (previously included developmental donors aged 3-17 years; measured fetal stage had 0 nuclei) fully preserved in donor_level_adult_pool_contrast (tier_id=...__adult_pool__v1.0); citations of v1.0 numbers must be linked to the contrast archive identity; signatures of the two tiers must not be mixed (red line).
